description: Navigate to the 'Scales Board' (balance/weighing) activity in GCompris and complete at least 3 levels. From the main menu, find the Science/Experiment category (flask icon) or Discovery category, locate the activity with a balance scale icon (often labeled 'Balance the scales' or similar). Launch it. In the activity, drag weights from the shelf onto the empty side of the balance scale to make it equal to the other side. Complete at least 3 distinct levels successfully.
